Intraday predicted dips alone are not settled-funding hits, and I’ll distinguish trading-pair removals from full spot delistings.

The final ranking emphasizes potential funding depth and duration, not just the chance of crossing −0.10%. I reviewed 96-hour paths for 64 contracts and episode histories for 30; probabilities are anchored to the 10.5% quiet-universe base rate and roughly 26–33% repeat-offender rates.

Borrow constraints remain inferred from thin spot turnover and market structure, not verified borrow quotes. I’ve also discounted isolated predicted dips, declining OI, and historical extremes that are unlikely to repeat; CHIP’s predicted-funding data is missing, although the screen explicitly classifies it as quiet.
